name: Cholec80
annotations: 7 phases at video-frame resolution; 7 tool-presence labels at 1 fps
split_status: Multiple published/project splits; exact split must be pinned per experiment
overlap: Source dataset for CholecT50 and CholecSeg8k; overlaps also documented by CAMMA with newer datasets
compute: ~85.2 GB extracted in TF-Cholec80 packaging; ~166 GB free space recommended during preparation
caution: Do not use CholecT50/CholecSeg8k/derived CholecInstanceSeg as independent external test without video-ID de-duplication.

name: CholecT50
annotations: Instrument–verb–target triplets; components; phase; limited box annotations
raw_video: Source videos available through dataset access
overlap: 45/50 videos are Cholec80; shares sequences with CholecSeg8k; source of CholecInstanceSeg
decision: Secondary task dataset; not independent validation for Cholec80

name: CholecSeg8k
access: Publicly circulated derived dataset; verify canonical release route before experiment
license: Exact canonical data-license route should be re-verified; source lineage inherits Cholec80 restrictions
raw_video: No independent raw-video source; derived from Cholec80
split_status: Derived-frame benchmark; video-level provenance must be enforced
overlap: Subset of 17 Cholec80 videos; 10 image sequences overlap CholecT50 by source sequence according to CholecInstanceSeg paper
caution: Do not call it external to Cholec80.

name: CholecInstanceSeg
fps: Mixed source sampling; includes sparse and full partitions
annotations: Semantic + instance IDs/masks for surgical tools
access: Annotations via Synapse; underlying images obtained from source datasets
license: Mixed/inherited source terms; verify each source dataset and Synapse terms
raw_video: Underlying source videos not redistributed as one independent corpus
split_status: Partitions explicitly track CholecSeg8k, CholecT50 and Cholec80 provenance
overlap: Composite of CholecT50, CholecSeg8k and Cholec80-derived imagery
natural_shift: Low as independent external domain; useful for dense tool labels
caution: Treat provenance at sequence/video level; not an independent domain.

name: Endoscapes2023
modality: Sampled video frames with temporal metadata/annotations
scale: 201 source videos; CVS201 has 11,090 annotated frames; Seg50 has 50-video subset
fps: CVS frames every 5 s; segmentation subset sparsely annotated
annotations: CVS by 3 experts; boxes; semantic/instance segmentation for subsets
tasks: CVS assessment; object detection; scene/instrument/anatomy segmentation
access: Current PhysioNet files are restricted access with signed DUA; official GitHub documents dataset structure
license: Route-sensitive: GitHub states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; PhysioNet-hosted files use Restricted Health Data License 1.5.0 + DUA
raw_video: Distributed release is annotation/frame-centric; full raw-video availability for arbitrary temporal corruption must be verified
split_status: Official video-level 120/41/40 for CVS/BBox; 30/10/10 for Seg50
overlap: CAMMA explicitly warns of overlaps among Endoscapes, Cholec80 and CholecT50; exact IDs must be resolved before cross-dataset testing
natural_shift: Limited centre diversity; strong clinical/safety label value
compute: Moderate; access administration is bigger constraint than storage
caution: Use current PhysioNet access/DUA terms for PhysioNet files; do not redistribute until terms are checked.

name: PhaKIR
scale: 8 complete public-release videos from 3 medical centres
annotations: Phase every frame; keypoints + instance segmentation at 1 fps; 19 instrument classes
tasks: Phase recognition; tool keypoints; instrument instance segmentation
access: Controlled access by request via Zenodo
split_status: Public release is 8 videos; original challenge used additional hidden test cases
overlap: Independent multicentre collection from German hospitals
caution: Too small to be sole training corpus; preserve centre identities for leave-one-centre-out tests.

name: HeiChole
annotations: 7 phases; 4 actions; 21 instruments/7 categories; 5 skill dimensions
access: Public OPARA bundle; original challenge also uses Synapse/hidden-test leaderboard
split_status: Original benchmark had unreleased test data; OPARA now provides a large public bundle—canonical challenge reproduction requires split verification
caution: Large storage; reconcile current public bundle with original hidden-test protocol before claiming leaderboard comparability.

name: MultiBypass140
access: Direct S3 downloads + official GitHub metadata/code
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial scientific research
split_status: Official 5-fold CV metadata; explicit cross-centre experiments supported
compute: Very high storage burden; visible archive parts alone are hundreds of GB
decision: High-value temporal validation candidate, currently practical hold
caution: As of 2026-09-25 an open issue reports `multibypass03.zip` contains metadata only/no videos; verify repair before committing experiments.

name: AutoLaparo
domain: Human clinical; Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong
annotations: Workflow phases; laparoscope motion; instrument + key-anatomy segmentation subsets
split_status: Published baseline uses procedure-level 10 train / 4 val / 7 test
natural_shift: Strong cross-procedure value; limited site diversity
caution: Different anatomy/procedure can create semantic-label mismatch, so cross-task comparisons need harmonization.

name: SAR-RARP50
scale: Challenge paper describes 50 RARP suturing video segments
fps: High-frame-rate source video; exact experiment sampling must be pinned
annotations: Instrument semantic segmentation + surgical action recognition
tasks: Instrument segmentation; action recognition; multitask learning
centres: Dataset collection context should be verified in paper metadata before site-shift claims
access: Direct UCL Research Data Repository train/test archives
split_status: Official challenge train/test archives; train ~25.1 GB, test ~6.15 GB
natural_shift: Moderate; direct robotic relevance is the main value
caution: Only one prostatectomy sub-phase; not representative of full surgery workflow.

name: ESAD / SARAS-ESAD
access: Grand Challenge registration; train/validation downloadable after registration
license: Challenge distribution is non-commercial/controlled; exact registered-user terms must be accepted
split_status: 22,601 train frames; 4,574 validation; 6,223 test frames listed, with test not publicly released on current page
caution: Very small procedure count and unreleased test constrain independent reliability studies.

name: JIGSAWS
procedure: Robotic surgical training tasks (suturing, knot-tying, needle passing)
annotations: Gesture segments; global skill scores; synchronized kinematics
access: Request form / alternative link if needed
license: Academic research only; not commercial (official page does not state a CC license)
caution: Do not treat bench-top training as clinical robotic surgery.

name: HeiCo / ROBUST-MIS 2019
modality: Surgical video / 10-s clips + sparse annotated frames
fps: Training clips contain 250 consecutive frames over ~10 s
annotations: Binary instrument segmentation; instance detection/segmentation; workflow labels in broader HeiCo resource
centres: Primarily one centre, but procedure-domain gap
split_status: Challenge test stages explicitly increase domain gap; no patient overlap between train/test reported
caution: Domain gap is mainly procedure/context, not multicentre networking.

name: CaDIS
domain: Human clinical; derived from CATARACTS training videos
fps: Images sampled at least ~0.3 s apart in published use
access: Official Grand Challenge page currently says download link 'coming up soon'
license: Dataset license not sufficiently verified from current primary access page; do not infer from article license
raw_video: Underlying CATARACTS videos exist, but CaDIS is a frame subset
natural_shift: Strong cross-procedure/camera diversity relative to laparoscopy
decision: Secondary spatial candidate pending access/license verification
caution: Current official download route appears incomplete.

name: CATARACTS
access: Published on IEEE DataPort / challenge route
license: Official challenge states dataset must not be used commercially; verify DataPort terms before redistribution
overlap: CaDIS uses frames from the 25 CATARACTS training videos
caution: Different imaging modality (microscope) makes shift large and task harmonization nontrivial.

name: EndoVis 2017 Robotic Instrument Segmentation
procedure: Robotic minimally invasive procedures; porcine background
license: Verify original challenge data terms; do not rely on third-party mirrors for licensing
natural_shift: Useful platform/domain shift, but porcine tissue is easier/different

name: EndoVis 2018 Robotic Scene Segmentation
license: Verify original challenge terms before experiment
caution: Porcine tissue is explicitly easier than human tissue in challenge report.

name: SurgVU
procedure: da Vinci robotic training exercises on porcine model
annotations: Tool install/presence, task labels; challenge-specific localisation subsets
tasks: Tool detection/presence; task recognition; long-video representation
access: Direct public dataset URLs / official repository
natural_shift: Useful platform scale, limited clinical realism
caution: Do not treat training exercises on porcine model as clinical human surgery.
